mentions.name: mensara
mentions.description: Multiplayer shared memory platform so a whole team can work together with AI coding software. It lets multiple AI agents (such as muse, grokbot, and dots) all know the user immediately and collaborate.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building mensara, multi player memory so you're whole team can work together with ai coding software.

One of the most fun things is you can use all the various agents, like muse, grokbot, dots etc and they all know you immediately and can work together.

Try it at www.mensara.ai
mentions.author: technotony
